# Pending lines of FuzzVIPDifferential (vip_differential_fuzz_test.go), the
# differential test of VIP-31.
#
# One line per construct of vipgen the compiler does not implement yet,
# keyed feature:<construct>, owned by compiler, naming its VIP and the lane
# that implements it. TestVIPConstructs runs every construct's probe, also
# under -short: a pending probe that passes fails as XPASS, so the lane that
# lands the construct deletes its line. Campaigns leave pending constructs out
# unless VIBELANG_FUZZ_PENDING=1. A generated program's gaps are keyed
# compile:<code>/<construct> and exit:<aspect>/<construct>. A construct's
# plain form (key suffix -plain) stands in a plain program, so it is compared
# before VIP-1's effect functions compile; one with no feature line is
# generated by every campaign.

FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip01.call-time           compiler  VIP-1: an effect function's parameters and defaults are not bound when it is called, outside the generator, with its body rerun on each run of the Effect, yet; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip01.super               compiler  VIP-1: `super.m(a)` in an effect method is not `$apply($super_get("m"), this, [a])`, looking m up before a and never reading its call property, yet; lane vip-core2 implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-function   compiler  VIP-5: `x catch (e) => f(e)` does not run x and give f(e) on a failure, a throw in f a defect (Effect.catch(x, (e) => Effect.succeed(f(e)))) yet; lane vip-core implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip05.catch-block-operand  compiler  VIP-5: `effect { … } catch v` does not run the block: the compiler wraps an effect-block operand of catch, or a const that holds one, in Effect.sync, so catch gives back the unrun Effect instead of running it ("`e catch h` runs `e`", Chapter 2); lane core-catch fixes it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip06.globals          compiler  VIP-6: succeed, fail, die and sync are not globals that name Effect.succeed, Effect.fail, Effect.die and Effect.sync yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip06.try-promise      compiler  VIP-6: tryPromise is not a global that names Effect.tryPromise yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-in                compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.in(scope) e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkIn(e, scope)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-outlives-function  compiler  VIP-17: a child of plain `fork` belongs to the current fiber ("a child is interrupted when its parent ends"; Chapter 2: `yield* Effect.forkChild(worker())`, owner "the current fiber"), but the compiler forks into a region of the enclosing effect function or region body (`runtime.$region(…)`, `runtime.$fork(e, scope_1)`), so the child is interrupted when that function returns or that `uninterruptible { … }` (or other region body) ends, and main's children are interrupted last-forked first where their fiber interrupts them in the order they were forked; lane w2-fork fixes it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-operand-eager  compiler  VIP-17: `fork e` is exact sugar for `Effect.forkChild(e)`, so e is evaluated at the fork, in the parent (Chapter 2: every operand is "evaluated once, left to right as written"), but the compiler evaluates it in the child: `const f = fork made(); ev("after")` logs after, then made; lane w2-fork fixes it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip04.throw-only-body  compiler  VIP-4: `throw e` in an effect function is `return yield* Effect.fail(e)` (Chapter 3), so a function whose only way out is a throw succeeds with never, but the compiler types its success as void: `const v: number = try h()` reports TS2322, and `v + 1` TS2365 (after-landing campaigns 20261030T0830 and T0900); lane impl-hunt-fail fixes it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip04.ts-throw-argument  compiler  VIP-4: calling a .ts function that returns an Effect is not throw-tracked, but its call is still evaluated where it stands, before the call that takes it (Chapter 2: every operand "evaluated once, left to right as written"; Will's OTHER-7: no type-directed call meaning). The compiler passes an Effect-typed argument by name, `Effect.ensuring(Effect.suspend(() => load()), fin)`, so load's throw comes after the finalizer is added and the finalizer logs (after-landing campaign 20261030T1030, vip22.finalizers); lane fix-w2-fork removes type-directed by-name passing everywhere, with vip17.fork-operand-eager
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip07.match-unreachable  compiler  VIP-7: a match whose arms cover a data union is exhaustive wherever it stands, but in code after a block that always returns the compiler reports EK4701 ("does not handle every case") and TS2339 on a bound field (after-landing campaign 20261030T1700, crasher 3f2ac66a, fz-func triage); lane fix-vip-match fixes it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-scoped            compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.scoped e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkScoped(e)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip17.fork-detached          compiler  VIP-17: `const f = fork.detached e` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.forkDetach(e)` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.all                    compiler  VIP-18: `try.all [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.all([a, b], { concurrency: "unbounded" })` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.race                   compiler  VIP-18: `try.race [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.raceAllFirst([a, b])` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.any                    compiler  VIP-18: `try.any [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.raceAll([a, b])` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip18.all-settled            compiler  VIP-18: `try.allSettled [a, b]` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.all([a, b].map(Effect.exit), { concurrency: "unbounded" })` yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip09.service            compiler  VIP-9: `service Svc0 { static readonly key = "app/Svc0"; base: number; get(n: number): number!! }` is not lowered to `class Svc0 extends Context.Service()("app/Svc0") {}`, got with `try Svc0` and called as `(try Svc0).get(n)` (VIP-10), yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip09.service-default    compiler  VIP-9: a service with `static readonly defaultValue` is not lowered to `Context.Reference(key, { defaultValue })`, usable with nothing providing it, yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip12.provide            compiler  VIP-12: `provide L, Svc0 = testSvc0 { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Effect.provide(Effect.gen(…), [L, Layer.succeed(Svc0, testSvc0)])` yet; lane vip-decls implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip14.modules            compiler  VIP-14: Effect's root modules (Option, Duration, Schedule, Schema, Stream, Effect) are not in scope without an import, nor Effect's Array module as `Effect.Array`, yet; lane vip-globals implements it
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip20.for-try              compiler  VIP-20: `for try (const x of s) { … }` is not lowered to `yield* Stream.runForEachWhile(s, (x) => Effect.gen(…))`, continue as return true and break as return false, yet; lane unassigned
FuzzVIPDifferential  feature:vip23.pipe                 compiler  VIP-23: `a |> f(%) |> g(%)` is not lowered to nested calls with each topic evaluated once into a temporary yet; lane unassigned

# Plain programs (vipgen.Program.Plain): every construct's plain form
# compiles today, and its Exit and events agree with the reference, but the
# compiler still lowers a plain function as an effect function. Keyed
# exit:called/<construct>, checked after the Exit and events, so these lines
# never hide another disagreement.
